Youtooz creates designer toys for the heroes and role models of the internet â Youtubers, Instagram influencers, celebrities, athletes, rappers, and more. Our mission is to bring the people you already love to watch and keep up with on the internet in real life, on your desk at work, your shelf in your bedroom or even in your living room for everyone to see. Youtooz are incredibly personal and unique to each creator and customer and comes with a variety of unique perks.

Concept Artists at Youtooz will create the aesthetic and look for our product. They are responsible for taking a content creator or popular IP and turning them into a 2D concept that fits the brandâs aesthetic guidelines and accurately personifies the creator.

Responsibilities

  • Research and capture a content creator's personality, mood, content, community and other defining features into a 2D collectible
  • Quickly create initial concepts and effectively incorporate feedback into following iterations
  • Interpret your 2D concept into turnarounds to prepare for 3D modeling

Qualifications

description:
Benefits/Perks

  • Competitive Pay
  • On the Job Training
  • Growth Opportunities
  • Flexible Schedules

Company Overview

Are you looking for a rewarding role in helping kids of all ages succeed in school? School is Easy Tutoring is committed to providing quality, individualized, educational programs to assist students with career, academic and personal goals.

Job Summary

We are looking for tutors in all education subjects to assist our growing community of students looking for help with their education.

We match our tutors and children together so that we maximize the experience for everyone. This matching enables us to focus on exactly the areas our students needs help in. This allows them to quickly gain more confidence to improve their confidence, grades, and overall experience in school.

Responsibilities

  • Reviewing student's needs and developing a plan to help them succeed
  • Assisting students with homework, projects, test preparation, papers, research, and other academic tasks
  • Teaching skills to improve academic performance, including study strategies, note-taking skills, and approaches to answering test questions
  • Providing students with positive and constructive feedback
  • Offering feedback on progress to students' parents where appropriate

Compensation: $25.00 per hour

School Is Easy is a proud member of the LaunchLife family of companies. For over 15 years, School Is Easy has been empowering students to succeed by delivering professional-level tutoring nationwide. In addition to our professionally skilled tutors for in-person and virtual sessions, School Is Easy offers students on-demand homework and test preparation assistance through our proprietary cloud-based system, Opus. School Is Easy tutoring system helps students succeed when a school education is not enough for them.
